name: Delilah
title: Samson's Fall
summary: Delilah was a woman from the Valley of Sorek whom Samson loved. The Philistine rulers bribed her to discover the secret behind Samson's strength. After repeated attempts, she got him to reveal that his strength lay in his hair, and she handed him over to the Philistines.

keyEvents.title: The Philistines' Offer
keyEvents.description: The Philistine rulers offered Delilah 1,100 silver pieces each to find the secret behind Samson's strength.

keyEvents.title: The Three Lies
keyEvents.description: Samson deceived Delilah three times with false explanations about his strength—bowstrings, new ropes, and woven braids.

keyEvents.title: Pressed Day After Day
keyEvents.description: Delilah pressed Samson day after day with words and tears until he was weary of life and revealed the truth.

keyEvents.title: Betrayed
keyEvents.description: Delilah lulled Samson to sleep and had a man cut off his seven locks of hair. His strength left him.

keyEvents.title: Surrender
keyEvents.description: Delilah handed the weakened Samson over to the Philistines, who gouged out his eyes and bound him.
